In order to create a sustainable Fediverse culture, we need to do the legwork of promoting content.
We create a community (Lemmy equivalent of a subreddit) for self-promotion.
A few years back I created this at /c/selfpromo , but creating the page is the easy part.
I just looked up a couple subreddits around self-promo but they seem to be all about NSFW content.

In that context, I believe one possiblity is to reach out to high quality creators on existing popular platforms (like YouTube, Instagram, etc) and invite them to share their creations on such a self-promo channel.
Commons outreach Instead of “self-promotion”, which has negative connotations (it fits ‘influencer-culture’ best), under Social coding commons and SX we speak of “Outreach” .

For this topic, yes you can do “self-promotion” on Lemmy, but the larger realization is that ANY communication online constitutes you doing outreach in hopes to get the most out of your time spent online.
